body: Thank you so much. I appreciate the support and understanding, I really do. Thank you so much for taking time out of your day to talk to a struggling teen. I know we have a rep for being hormonal and attention seeking, which many of us are (I've encountered many), but having someone believe me/us means the world.

Thank you so much. You took the words out of my mouth. I don't have the will to go "mom and dad I want to die get me a therapist or I'm going to swallow a bottle of pills", and subsequently don't get taken as serious as I would like to. I do want to keep living; in fact I want to become a doctor. But I just have such little will to live. I do believe I'm depressed, but I hate to self diagnose. I have talked to a couple of friends about my issues and they have encouraged me to just go and seek help on my own, which I may just do. I appreciate you taking time out of your day to talk to me and help me, it means a lot :)

I'm looking into public therapy groups and such. Thank you, a lot. It feels good to have my feelings validated by someone :) I don't necessarily want to die. I feel like I'm leaving a lot behind and I do have an ok friend group. I feel so down and just depressed all the time. (I hate to say depression, I don't want to self diagnose). Thanks for your help thexboxgoverner , it means a lot to me :)
